notes: Gnarled Sage (M21), the 'this turn' scope. Printed: 'As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, this creature gets +0/+2 and has vigilance.' Seat 0 draws two (Thrill of Possibility), then the turn passes to seat 1. On seat 1's turn seat 0 has drawn no cards THIS turn, so the Sage is back to 4/4 with reach only. A dropped 'this turn' scope (counting draws of earlier turns) would keep it 4/6 with vigilance.
